title: Crazy Rich Asians
tagline: Hawker centre first. Then the family.
about: A New York professor flies to Singapore to meet her boyfriend's family and finds out they're incredibly rich.
cue: Serve the snacks when Rachel gets her first taste of the hawker centre.
